description: Requests a task from the human provider, free. Either catalogue_id (a fixed position: technical verdict 250 EUR, infrastructure rescue 450 EUR with a 200 EUR diagnostic first, signed observation in Cyprus from 200 EUR) or service_id with price_eur; payer is the address you will pay from. The provider accepts or declines within 1 hour 07:00–18:00 Cyprus time, otherwise within 24 hours; the scope is frozen and hashed. After acceptance get_status returns exactly one payment leg: escrow (recommended; USDC held by Coinbase's immutable AuthCaptureEscrow, reclaimable by you after the deadline), a direct transfer invoice, or an x402 order. Nothing is payable before acceptance.

acceptance_criteria.description: how you will judge the result

catalogue_id.description: a fixed catalogue position from list_services (sets service_id and the price)

deadline.description: when it must be done (ISO date or plain words)

description.description: what exactly to do and where

payer.description: your EVM address on Base: it signs the escrow authorisation, or it is the only address whose direct transfer pays the invoice

payment_flow.description: how you will pay after acceptance: escrow (recommended; USDC only), direct transfer against the invoice, or x402 (POST {task_id} to /x402/order)

reply_to.description: https URL, email or wallet address for the reply; never published

task_days.description: escrow only: days after acceptance until you may reclaim

name: request_action
title: Order a service from the human provider
